A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, with matching authors, BO-DDNM method, theoretical framework and simulations. The complete main texts and appendices are readable, and retained material can be matched across renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original Gaussian and Gaussian-mixture simulations comparing samplers and examining distributional bias in Figures 1–2, with settings in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains these original simulation results in Figures 1–2 and their experimental descriptions in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The sampling procedure in Equation (6), BO-DDNM rectification in Equation (10), and noise schedules remain unchanged. Revisions to theorem conditions and explanations do not introduce a different algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Gaussian and two-component Gaussian-mixture conditional sampling scenarios, including the same measurement-noise, conditioning and correlation variations.

E2.justification: Figure 1 retains DDNM and DDNM+ as the evaluated comparators against BO-DDNM. Newly cited guidance papers are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Appendix C's simulation descriptions are identical, including dimensions, mixture parameters, noise schedules and KL-divergence evaluation. Both retain 150000 samples for mixture-divergence estimation and T = 20000 for Figure 2.

E4.justification: The measurement-noise comparisons and sensitivity analyses of conditioning y and correlation rho are unchanged. No new ablation, robustness test or empirical supplementary analysis appears.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed identifiers, confidence intervals or significance tests. The random parameter generation and Monte Carlo divergence-estimation descriptions remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Figures 1–2 contain identical embedded plot images, retaining the same curves, rankings and bias trends. No experimental result entries are added, removed or numerically revised.

T1.justification: Theorem 1 newly requires an analytic target density, Proposition 1 explicitly requires positive covariance eigenvalues, and Corollary 1 restricts the noise-schedule condition to t >= 2. Appendix I.2 also adds a flawed bound, 1 - alpha_bar_t >= 1 - delta, inconsistent with Equation (8). These are localized changes; convergence-rate formulas and most proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same principal claims: general score-mismatch guarantees, accumulated asymptotic bias, bias-optimal BO-DDNM and explicit parameter dependencies. Correcting 'two factors' to 'three' merely matches the three factors already listed in v1.

C2.justification: Section 3.1 newly explains when target-distribution estimation accuracy may be plausible and why mismatch demands greater accuracy than matched sampling. Section 4.2 adds an assertion that the Gaussian-mixture results extend from coordinate-selection H to general H, without providing a revised full proof.

D1.justification: The numerical simulation recipes, parameter choices and sample counts in Appendix C are unchanged. No new implementation instructions, hardware information, or code/data access information is supplied.

R1.justification: v2 adds Bradley and Nakkiran and Chidambaram et al. on classifier-free guidance, plus Li et al. on accelerated diffusion. It also changes its characterization of Xu and Chi's likelihood assumptions from 'differentiable or bounded' to 'differentiable and bounded'; the overall research positioning remains similar.

P1.justification: v2 expands and reorganizes the assumption discussion, algebraically simplifies the presentation of Assumptions 3–4, and makes localized language and author-header edits. New Appendix E repeats Section 5's proof sketch verbatim, shifting subsequent appendix labels; the main narrative structure is retained.

P2.justification: The author block is compacted and the proof-sketch decomposition is reformatted into displayed equations with labeled underbraces. Figures 1–2 retain their images, captions and sizes but move lower on page 9. The appendix contents are reformatted, with some page references no longer matching their destinations.

improvement.justification: Explicit theorem conditions and Corollary 1's corrected early-stopping scope modestly improve precision, while expanded explanations and related work clarify applicability. The gains are limited by the duplicated proof sketch and a new Appendix I.2 error: Equation (8) supports 1 - alpha_bar_t >= delta, rather than >= 1 - delta. That correct weaker bound still suffices for the constant-bound argument, making this a localized regression rather than a loss of the retained result. Methods and empirical evidence are unchanged.
